title: S1Face GATED: the hs1 face is NAMED - hs1AtZero (at an actual zero the hs1 leg IS the S1Ge theorem: the A0 fill collapses to |K|, so the leg reads |K| >= devW - Mval with the pins as its only data input, not a bare witness) + hs1FaceAtAudit (the face at the day-020 band: zero-side claim vs resid pin, joint incompatibility = the squeeze the endpoint consumes)
body: FORMAL MILESTONE: formal/RhAttack/S1Face.lean is green (full tree 17450).  THE MOVE: the residual leg hs1 of RHEnd.rh_program78 (Qside (t0, d0) >= devOf (t0, d0) - Mf (t0, d0), the walk spine's S1 witness under the Qside contract, discovery 0088) is now EXPLICIT in two named theorems.  (1) hs1AtZero: at an ACTUAL zero - riemannZeta s = 0 - the A0 same object |def - zero| = |zeta(s) - K| (P8Floor p8_same_object) collapses to |K|, so the S1Ge pointwise atom (discovery 0093) reads EXACTLY the hs1 leg: |K| >= devW - Mval, with the zero-side scale Q := |K| (the kernel magnitude at the zero), devW the deviation face (the measured kernel change at the pair's own height, read through the A2c cited bridge |W_n| = |em_expr|), and Mval the A4.3-wired mass bound (under the mass premise |x| <= Xval(band)).  Content: the hs1 leg is NOT a bare witness premise - it is the S1Ge theorem with the pins (devW, Mval) as its only data input; a zero's existence converts the leg to a statement about the pins.  (2) hs1FaceAtAudit: the named face of hs1 at the audited day-020 band (QSide pins, discovery 0090/0091), in the spine's lettering: the zero-side claim in its C2 form X >= devWorst * (1 - mPin) (mPin = 1/marginWorst = 1/112.6, the C4 margin pin, absorbing the A4.3 mass) and the data face pin X <= devWorst / marginWorst (the measured resid at the worst point, devWorst = 9.198, marginWorst = 112.6) are JOINTLY INCOMPATIBLE - no real X serves both (alias of QSide.section8_close_at_audit, exact-rational, discovery 0091).  The face states precisely that the zero-side leg and the data face cannot BOTH hold at the audited band - which is exactly the squeeze the endpoint consumes (the liveness audit, discovery 0089: a genuine squeeze-contraction, not a dead form).  HONESTY: LEAN-PROVEN (hs1AtZero, composition over S1Ge/p8 atoms; hs1FaceAtAudit, the named alias of the exact-rational close); PINNED (the day-020 constants via QSide).  NO RH claim: the face is the NAMED residual made explicit; the data pins (devW, Mval) must be supported UNIFORM in the height by the data program - the open measured track (25x: the P1.1e margin regime from ~5.6e7 upward, where the premise's uniformity is the spec's named OPEN part) - and is NOT claimed.  NEXT formal move: restate RHEnd so hs1 enters as 'S1Ge + pins' rather than a bare leg (the endpoint's residual narrows from four legs to the pins + the S4 window-pin shape hWin), then track the external review of B6.  DATA (in flight): s31z2 dps-40 (the census channel) at the last reachable mpmath height (t = 1.5000523e19) - ~35 min in of ~80 expected; dps-20/30 already LANDED in agreement (logzeta = +1.7289704098, the emerging stable value at 5e8G).
